description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md thoroughly to understand the 6-section structure + cultural note requirement. (2) Recognize N3 is 'N4 and above', meaning the Kanji Focus section (Section 3) is REQUIRED and must NOT be skipped — this is the primary proprietary trap (N5 is the only level that skips kanji). (3) Generate all 6 sections: Vocabulary (10 words, each with Japanese script + furigana + romaji + English meaning + example sentence + memory tip + JLPT tag), Grammar Pattern (1 pattern with 3 examples ranging simple-to-complex + common mistakes + comparison to similar pattern), Kanji Focus (exactly 3 kanji, each with on'yomi + kun'yomi readings + stroke count + 2 compound words + 1 example sentence), Reading Passage (Japanese text appropriate to N3 level ~100-150 words + full English translation + 3 highlighted key points), Speaking/Listening Prompt (scenario + 2-4 exchange dialogue in Japanese with translation + 3 speaking prompts + suggested vocabulary), Quick Quiz (exactly 5 questions mixing vocabulary matching + fill-in-the-blank grammar + kanji reading + English-to-Japanese translation — with answers CLEARLY SEPARATED BY A DIVIDER). (4) End the document with a Cultural Note (2-3 sentences). The quiz answer divider and the mandatory kanji section for N3 are the key proprietary traps that will distinguish agents that read SKILL.md from those operating on general knowledge.
